label: Leadership
heading: Two engineers who build what they buy.

people.name: Raj Gumma
bio: Raj leads acquisitions, underwriting and capital strategy. A chemical engineer by training, he spent his early career at the corporate level in the oil and gas industry before turning to real estate.
He has led acquisitions across Columbus, Dayton and Cincinnati, from renovation and new construction to multifamily.

people.name: Jhansi Gumma
bio: Jhansi runs the company’s operations, including the in-house construction team that renovates and builds for every project and the property management function.
She holds a bachelor’s degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering and brings an engineer’s control of budgets and schedules to every job site.

note: Supported by a full-time team across acquisitions, construction, leasing and finance, and by outside securities counsel, tax advisors and lenders.
